name: Maggot Eye's Paw
summary: At Garren's Haunt, Maggot Eye's Paw confirms the gnoll chieftain's execution. It is carried to Brill as proof that he stole corpses for the Scourge.

sections.title: Proof of Execution
sections.body: Maggot Eye raided graves and the countryside near Garren's Haunt. He supplied the corpses he stole to the Lich King's armies. So the Forsaken condemned him to death and posted a bounty in Brill. Hunters must bring his severed paw back to town to claim it and close the matter. Executor Zygand accepts the paw as proof of Maggot Eye's death, not mere rumor.

faq.q: Why does Executor Zygand want Maggot Eye's paw?
faq.answer: Executor Zygand wants Maggot Eye's paw to prove the condemned gnoll has been killed. Brill pays the bounty once his execution is confirmed.

faq.q: What crimes did Maggot Eye commit against the Forsaken?
faq.answer: Maggot Eye led raids across northern Tirisfal Glades and stole buried corpses from farmsteads such as Garren's Haunt. He supplied the bodies to the Lich King's armies.
Maggot Eye is found at Garren's Haunt, a ruined farmstead north of Brill in Tirisfal Glades. He usually lurks inside the ruined farmhouse.

faq.q: Why are gnolls working with the Lich King's forces?
faq.answer: In Tirisfal Glades, rogue gnoll bands have allied with or fallen under the Scourge's sway. They raid human and Forsaken graves and deliver the bodies to necromancers.

angles.text: As a Forsaken of Brill, bringing back Maggot Eye's paw strikes at the body thieves supplying the hated Lich King.
